_about: The feelings wheel: six families, each with an inner ring of six words and an outer ring of six, in the wheel's clockwise order from the top. Used by the printed cards (scripts/build-feelings-cards.py) and the game (/tools/feelings-wheel/). colour names a token in tailor-site-v2.css. face is the family's button face, drawn in a 24-unit box centred on 12,12; {c} is the feature colour.
